Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two MS experiments: one for identifying unknown co-purifying proteins (standard DDA) and one for Cross-linking MS (XL-MS) using the DSBU crosslinker. The XL-MS component maps to the mod_tpp (topological/protein-protein interaction) modifier logic in Stage 4 routing. While the study discusses ubiquitination extensively, the MS was used for complex identification and cross-linking, not for ubiquitylome enrichment (no diGly/K-GG antibodies used for MS).

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics (LC-MS/MS and XL-MS) was used to identify co-purifying proteins and map interactions within the complex. The primary biological comparison is the structural transition of the E3 ligase complex from an inactive stacked state to an active dimeric state triggered by the presence of substrates (c-Jun or ETS2).
